title.ko: 관용어: back to square one · on edge · bite the bullet · hit the ground running

explain.ko: 관용어(idiom)는 전체 뜻이 각 단어의 뜻과 다른 고정 표현입니다. 업무와 감정에 관한 관용어가 특히 많습니다: back to square one(원점), bite the bullet(감수하다), hit the ground running(즉시 성과), on edge(불안한), on cloud nine(최고로 행복한), pass the buck(책임 전가). 관용어는 어순과 단어를 바꾸지 않고 덩어리째 사용해야 하며, 격식 있는 글에서는 신중하게 씁니다.
explain.en: An idiom is a fixed expression whose whole meaning differs from its words. There are many for work and emotion: back to square one (start over), bite the bullet (endure), hit the ground running (perform immediately), on edge (anxious), on cloud nine (extremely happy), pass the buck (shift blame). Idioms should be used as chunks without changing words, and carefully in formal writing.

notes.ko: 관용어는 단어를 바꾸지 말고 통째로 외우세요.
notes.en: Learn idioms whole without altering words.

notes.ko: 격식 있는 글이나 번역에서는 관용어를 일반 표현으로 바꾸세요.
notes.en: In formal writing or translation, paraphrase idioms.
Check context to see if the meaning is figurative.

lines.t: Idioms cannot be taken literally. For example, break the ice does not mean breaking ice but easing an awkward atmosphere. At work, knowing common idioms like hit the ground running makes conversation more natural.

prompt.ko: 관용어를 사용해 직장에서의 힘든 상황과 극복을 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Use idioms to write 4 sentences about a hard situation at work and how it was overcome.

task.model: The project was cancelled and we were back to square one. I bit the bullet and drew up a new plan. When the team hit the ground running, the mood improved. Finally, at the news of success, we were all on cloud nine.

model_trans.ko: 프로젝트가 취소되어 우리는 처음으로 돌아갔습니다. 저는 이를 악물고 새로운 계획을 세웠습니다. 팀원들이 바로 성과를 내자 분위기가 좋아졌습니다. 마침내 성공 소식에 모두 하늘을 나는 기분이었습니다.
model_trans.en: The project was cancelled and we were back to square one. I bit the bullet and drew up a new plan. When the team hit the ground running, the mood improved. Finally, at the news of success, we were all on cloud nine.
